story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by pioneers and laggards. Pioneers always tell the truth, and laggards always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Aria, and Riley. Aria said, "Riley is a laggard or Riley is a pioneer." Riley noted, "Riley is a pioneer or Aria is a pioneer". So who is a pioneer and who is a laggard?
